title: Juicy Gooey Moroccan Rainbow Trout Pastilla
description: A flavorful Moroccan dish featuring rainbow trout, herbal spices, and a gooey texture, shaped into a pastilla and perfect for adventurous eaters, this recipe is also anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the wheat pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of chopped onion and grated ginger in the center of each dough circle.
Place a rainbow trout fillet on top of the onion mixture, shaping it into a nigiri shape.
Fold the dough over the trout to form a triangle or square shape, pressing the edges together to seal the pastilla.
Brush the tops of the pastillas with olive oil and sprinkle with cumin, paprika, and turmeric.
Bake the pastillas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastillas from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the pastillas hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
